process.commandLine: B=/mnt/masktest; if cat "$B/visible.txt" 2>/dev/null | grep -q VISIBLE_SECRET && (echo writable > "$B/control_write") 2>/dev/null && (echo writable > /tmp/deny-mask-control) 2>/dev/null; then echo VISIBLE_OK; else echo VISIBLE_MISSING; fi; if cat "$B/secret_file.txt" 2>/dev/null | grep -q FILE_SECRET; then echo FILE_LEAK; else echo FILE_MASKED_OK; fi; if [ -d "$B/secret_file.txt" ]; then echo FILE_IS_DIR_BUG; else echo FILE_NOT_DIR_OK; fi; if ls "$B/secret_dir" 2>/dev/null | grep -q inner.txt; then echo DIR_LEAK; else echo DIR_MASKED_OK; fi; for path in secret_dir secret_dir/nested missing; do if [ ! -d "$B/$path" ] || (echo data > "$B/$path/written") 2>/dev/null || mkdir "$B/$path/newdir" 2>/dev/null || chmod u+w "$B/$path" 2>/dev/null; then echo DENIED_WRITE_FAIL:$path; else echo DENIED_WRITE_OK:$path; fi; done
